name: Music & Dance of the World
subtitle: Balkan Kolo, Dizi & more
shortDescription: 10 instruments and dances to play: Balkan kolo, Bansuri bamboo flute, Cueca and Dabke line dance.
longDescription:
Music & Dance of the World: 10 instruments and dances from 23 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Balkan kolo, Bansuri bamboo flute, Cueca, Dabke line dance, Dizi, Fufu Pounding Rhythm, Mijwiz Double Clarinet, Ribbon-Pole Plaiting Dance, Schuhplattler and Ukulele strum-along.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can play instruments and dances, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
